issues.description: The problem specification (UML and text) indicates acceptSupplyDelivery should be a public static method on SealSaloon, but the reference implementation declares it with package-private visibility (no access modifier). This visibility mismatch could confuse students about the expected API and may cause access problems if tests or usage expect a public static method.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the method declaration to be public (e.g., public static void acceptSupplyDelivery(String name, int price, int quantity)) so it matches the UML and problem description and is unambiguously accessible as part of the SealSaloon API.
